bullets.text: Turtlebox Ranger Review: Compact Power - This rugged Bluetooth speaker impresses with quality sound and strong battery life.
iOS 26.4 Enhances iCloud - New search feature improves web access for files and photos on iCloud.
Siri Mode Coming to Camera - iOS 27 will introduce a new Siri mode with enhanced Visual Intelligence features.
AI Actors Ineligible for Oscars - New rules state only human performances and screenplays can win Academy Awards.
Ask.com Shuts Down - The once-popular Q&A service has officially closed its doors after 30 years.
Every iPhone Now Has MagSafe - Apple's latest iPhones include MagSafe, a feature absent in Samsung devices.
Uber's Data Collection Ambitions - Uber plans to turn its drivers' cars into data-collection platforms for AV companies.
Google's New Travel Features - Google introduces tools for tracking hotel prices and enhancing travel planning.
Heybike's Ranger 3.0 Pro Deal - This foldable ebike is now $500 off, making it a strong alternative to cars.
